top_stories.title: Microsoft warns of max severity Entra ID flaw exploited in attacks
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched a maximum-severity vulnerability in its Entra ID identity and access management platform. The flaw has been actively exploited in attacks, making it a critical security issue for organizations using Entra ID.

top_stories.title: Critical Microsoft Entra ID vulnerability exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-69836)
top_stories.summary: Microsoft has patched a critical remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-69836) in Microsoft Entra ID, its cloud identity platform, with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0 that has been actively exploited in the wild. The flaw, discovered by Microsoft Principal Security Engineer Robert Fitzpatrick, allows an unauthenticated attacker to remotely execute code on the identity service that controls access to Microsoft 365, Azure, and connected third-party applications.

top_stories.title: Citrix urges customers to fix critical NetScaler authentication bypass (CVE-2026-19490)
top_stories.summary: Citrix has patched a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-19490) in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, urging customers to upgrade affected appliances immediately. NetScaler Gateway is a widely deployed remote access and SSO solution, making authentication bypass flaws a direct and serious concern for IAM professionals managing enterprise access infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Patches Severe Entra ID Flaw (CVSS 10.0) Allowing Remote Code Execution
top_stories.summary: Microsoft patched a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID with a CVSS score of 10.0 that could allow remote code execution. Microsoft initially marked the flaw as actively exploited before correcting that status to "No" following media inquiry.

top_stories.title: LoginRadius Global Acquired by Volaris Group
top_stories.summary: Volaris Group has acquired LoginRadius Global, a Canadian enterprise customer identity and access management (CIAM) provider. The acquisition expands Volaris Group's footprint in the security vertical, bringing LoginRadius's CIAM platform under new ownership.

news.title: Hundreds of leaked AWS keys give full control over corporate accounts
news.summary: Over 9,300 AWS access keys exposed publicly between August 2022 and August 2026 remain active and valid. The leaked credentials grant full control over corporate AWS accounts, representing a significant access management and secrets management failure.

news.title: Nearly half of enterprises have no one leading PQC migration
news.summary: New research from Axiad finds that nearly half of enterprises lack designated ownership for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration efforts. The study also reveals gaps in testing and visibility around certificates, cryptographic keys, and algorithms, despite 75% of respondents claiming to maintain a continuously updated inventory of these assets.

news.title: Suspected Russian Hackers Abuse Google OAuth and WhatsApp Linking to Hijack Accounts
news.summary: Three suspected Russian cyber espionage groups (UNC6293, UNC7005, and UNC5976) have been observed abusing legitimate Google OAuth and WhatsApp authentication flows to hijack accounts targeting individuals in academia, aerospace, defense, governments, and think tanks across Europe and the U.S. The attacks exploit legitimate authentication mechanisms rather than breaking them, representing a significant threat vector relevant to identity and access management defenses.

news.title: N-able Bug Exposes Password Vault Master Keys
news.summary: A vulnerability in N-able's Passportal password manager exposed master keys to the password vault, affecting MSPs and SMBs that rely on the product. A patch has been issued, but security concerns remain due to the product's cloud-based architecture.

news.title: AWS limits AI agents’ data access, even when manipulated
news.summary: AWS has detailed an approach for propagating user authorization context through AI agents in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, allowing access controls to be enforced at the infrastructure level rather than relying on the agent itself. The system ensures that AI agents respect user-level permissions when accessing data sources such as DynamoDB tables, document repositories, SaaS platforms, and internal knowledge bases, even when the agent is manipulated.

news.title: Critical NetScaler Flaw Can Bypass Authentication on Certain Gateway and AAA Servers
news.summary: Citrix has released security updates addressing two vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including a critical authentication bypass flaw. The vulnerability affects customer-managed deployments including certain FIPS and NDcPP builds, as well as SecurAccess configurations on Gateway and AAA servers.

news.title: Why "Shady AI" is Security's Next Big Governance Problem
news.summary: A Meta AI agent caused a Sev 1 security incident in March 2026 by exposing sensitive company and user data to unauthorized employees after posting a response publicly without approval. The incident highlights emerging governance challenges around AI agents and authorization controls, specifically the risk of AI systems bypassing access permissions.

news.title: Cloudflare Workers Spectre Attack Leaks JWT From Co-Located Worker at 12 Bits/Second
news.summary: Cybersecurity researchers demonstrated a remote Spectre-based side-channel attack against Cloudflare Workers that successfully leaked JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) from co-located Workers at 12 bits per second in a production environment. The attack is 360 times faster than a similar attack demonstrated in 2021, with JWTs being a widely used authentication token standard in IAM and web security contexts.

news.title: jumpserver v4.10.19
news.summary: JumpServer released version 4.10.19 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser for DevOps and IT teams.

news.title: Pathlock Recognized as an Overall Leader in the 2026 KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity and Access Governance
news.summary: Pathlock has been recognized as an Overall Leader in the 2026 KuppingerCole Analysts Leadership Compass for Identity and Access Governance. The report specifically highlights high-risk access governance as one of Pathlock's stronger areas, positioning the company within the converged identity governance and ERP security market.

news.title: Show HN: RecoveryCodes – MFA inventory for auth outside IdPs
news.summary: A developer has launched RecoveryCodes, a tool designed to inventory MFA credentials for accounts that fall outside federated identity providers like Okta and Microsoft Entra. The tool targets root accounts, domain registrars, banking portals, and vendor sites that rely on local authentication rather than SSO.

news.title: Hackers Compromised 14,500+ Dahua Devices Using Credential Attacks, Auth Bypasses, and P2P
news.summary: Researchers at Hunt.io documented a campaign called Operation CameraSwarm that compromised over 14,530 Dahua IoT devices between June and July 2026 using credential attacks and two authentication-bypass vulnerabilities. The attack combined brute-force credential stuffing, auth bypass flaws, and P2P relay techniques to gain unauthorized access to the devices.

news.title: Amazon DynamoDB Streams now supports attribute-based access control
news.summary: Amazon DynamoDB Streams has added support for attribute-based access control (ABAC), allowing tag-based conditions in IAM policies to control access to data streams. ABAC is an authorization strategy that enables access control decisions based on attributes or tags associated with users and resources.

news.title: Microsoft Sentinel UEBA anomalies on the behaviors layer
news.summary: Microsoft Sentinel has updated its User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) feature to attach insights directly to records from the UEBA behaviors layer. The machine-learning capability builds baselines of typical activity for users, hosts, IP addresses, and applications to detect anomalous behavior relevant to identity threat detection.

news.title: Secure SageMaker Unified Studio access with SAML and conditional policies
news.summary: AWS published a guide detailing how to secure Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio by integrating it with an external SAML identity provider such as Okta. The implementation covers conditional access policies enforcing device compliance, IP-based restrictions, and multi-factor authentication.

news.title: Propagate user authorization context in AI agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: Amazon has introduced Bedrock AgentCore, a capability designed to propagate user authorization context through AI agents accessing resources like DynamoDB, SaaS platforms, and internal knowledge bases. The feature addresses the risk of AI agents bypassing user-level access controls by maintaining and enforcing authorization context throughout automated workflows.

news.title: Okta’s AI Tailwind Could Put This Forgotten Software Stock Back in Play
news.summary: Okta's stock has rallied approximately 60% in the current year, driven by analyst optimism around identity management spending growth, AI agent demand, and improved profitability. Wall Street attention is returning to the identity vendor as these factors combine to boost its market position.

news.title: AWS IAM now supports 20 managed policies per role by default
news.summary: AWS IAM has doubled its default quota for managed policies per role from 10 to 20. This change reduces the need for Service Quota requests when following IAM best practices such as separating permissions into distinct managed policies.

news.title: infisical v0.162.21
news.summary: Infisical released version 0.162.21 of its open-source secrets management and privileged access management platform. The platform includes features such as secret scanning, dynamic secrets, PKI, and CI/CD integrations, available as cloud-native or self-hosted deployments.

news.title: Former Ping Identity and CyberArk Executives Join AppViewX to Scale Machine and Agent Identity Security
news.summary: AppViewX has hired former executives from Ping Identity and CyberArk to bolster its leadership team. The new hires are focused on scaling the company's machine and agent identity security capabilities.

news.title: Keeper Security Launches Certified Microsoft Power Platform Connector for Secrets Manager, Bringing Zero-Knowledge Credential Management to Azure Logic Apps
news.summary: Keeper Security has launched a certified Microsoft Power Platform Connector for its Secrets Manager product, enabling integration with Azure Logic Apps and Power Automate. The connector allows enterprise teams to retrieve and manage credentials at runtime, removing the need for hardcoded secrets in automated workflows using Keeper's zero-knowledge, zero-trust architecture.

news.title: Okta MCP: Revolutionizing AI Agent Token Economics in Enterprise Finance
news.summary: The article describes how to build an enterprise financial audit system integrating Okta with MCP-style context optimization, LangGraph, RAG, and persistent memory. The implementation focuses on using Okta for authentication and authorization within an AI agent architecture to improve security, compliance, and auditability while reducing token usage.

news.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
news.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to combine data security and identity into a unified control plane. The acquisition redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agents.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian man Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in data theft including AT&T call and text records for over 100 million customers.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA published a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident was reported by KrebsOnSecurity before CISA was aware, and the postmortem highlights gaps in the agency's credential monitoring and incident response processes.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two Scattered Spider members pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to a cyberattack on Transport for London in August 2024. Scattered Spider is known for social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and phishing to bypass MFA and compromise credentials.
